profiles.name: Maria & Carlos Rodriguez
profiles.description: Married couple, combined income $95,000. First-time homebuyers looking in suburban Detroit. Credit score around 650. Searching for a 3-bedroom home around $220,000. Limited savings with about $10,000 for down payment. Maria is a nurse and Carlos works in automotive manufacturing. No previous homeownership experience.

profiles.name: James Mitchell
profiles.description: Single professional, software engineer earning $130,000 annually. Excellent credit score of 780. Has $60,000 saved for down payment. Looking to buy a condo in downtown Detroit around $300,000. First-time buyer but strong financial position with no existing debt.

profiles.name: Sarah & Tom Wilson
profiles.description: Army veteran Tom and wife Sarah, combined income $85,000. Tom served 8 years active duty in the Army. Credit score 710. Looking for a family home in Grand Rapids around $250,000. No down payment saved. Two children, looking for good school district.

profiles.name: Priya Sharma
profiles.description: Single first-time buyer, medical resident earning $65,000. Credit score 640 with student loan debt. Looking for a starter home around $180,000 in Ann Arbor suburbs. Only $8,000 saved for down payment. Young professional just starting career.

profiles.name: Robert & Lisa Chen
profiles.description: Dual income household, both physicians with combined income of $420,000. Excellent credit scores above 760. Looking for a luxury home in Bloomfield Hills priced around $950,000. Have $200,000 available for down payment. Relocating from Chicago for hospital positions.

profiles.name: Kevin O'Brien
profiles.description: Retired Navy Chief Petty Officer, pension income $55,000 plus part-time consulting at $30,000. Credit score 730. Looking for a home near the VA hospital in Ann Arbor around $280,000. 20 years of military service. Wants a single-story ranch home.

profiles.name: Amanda & Derek Foster
profiles.description: Young married couple, combined income $110,000. Good credit at 720. This is their second home purchase, upgrading from a starter condo. Looking for a 4-bedroom home around $350,000 in Novi. Have equity from current home sale for 15% down payment.

profiles.name: Marcus Johnson
profiles.description: Single father, warehouse supervisor earning $52,000. Credit score 610 with some past collections now resolved. First-time buyer looking for affordable housing around $150,000 in Lansing. Has $6,000 saved. Stable employment for 5 years at the same company.

profiles.name: Jennifer & Michael Park
profiles.description: Married couple, combined income $160,000. Both work in automotive industry. Credit scores around 740. Looking for a home in Troy around $400,000 with 20% down payment saved. Second-time buyers, selling current home in Sterling Heights. Want top-rated school district.

profiles.name: David & Karen Mueller
profiles.description: Farming family with household income of $62,000 looking to purchase a home in rural Gratiot County. Moderate credit score of 660. Want a home with some acreage around $175,000 in a small agricultural community. Income below area median. Currently renting on a neighboring farm.

profiles.name: Angela Washington
profiles.description: Single professional, teacher earning $58,000 with credit score of 670. First-time buyer looking for a home around $190,000 in Kalamazoo. Has $9,000 saved from a down payment assistance program. Wants to stop renting and build equity. Stable 8-year employment.

profiles.name: Steven & Amy Nakamura
profiles.description: High-income tech couple, combined earnings $350,000. Excellent credit at 790. Looking for a waterfront property on Lake Michigan priced around $1,200,000. Have substantial savings and investment portfolio. Want a vacation home that could become primary residence eventually.

profiles.name: Chris Taylor
profiles.description: Marine Corps veteran, currently working as a police officer earning $72,000. Credit score 700. Served 6 years active duty. Looking for a home around $230,000 in Traverse City. Wants to use VA loan benefit for zero down. Single, first home purchase.

profiles.name: Rachel & Brian Kowalski
profiles.description: Married couple in their 40s, combined income $95,000. Good credit at 710. Looking to buy a home in small-town Cadillac, Michigan around $160,000. Brian is a mechanic and Rachel manages a local restaurant. Want to be closer to family in northern Michigan. Moderate savings.

profiles.name: Omar & Fatima Hassan
profiles.description: Immigrant family, combined income $78,000. Credit score 630, building credit history in the US for 3 years. First-time homebuyers looking for a family home around $200,000 in Dearborn. Omar works in engineering and Fatima is a translator. Want to plant roots in their community.

profiles.name: Patricia Gonzalez
profiles.description: School administrator earning $48,000 looking for an affordable home in rural Isabella County. Credit score 650. Income qualifies as below area median. Wants a quiet community near Mount Pleasant around $130,000. Single, looking for a smaller 2-bedroom home with a yard.

profiles.name: Daniel & Michelle Brooks
profiles.description: Established couple, combined income $185,000. Excellent credit at 750. Upgrading to a larger home in Rochester Hills around $500,000. Selling current home with significant equity for 25% down. Daniel is a financial analyst and Michelle is a dental hygienist. Third home purchase.

profiles.name: Tyler Reed
profiles.description: Air Force veteran, 12 years of service, now working as an airline pilot earning $95,000. Credit score 740. Looking for a home near Detroit Metro Airport around $320,000. Eligible for VA benefits. Recently married, wants to settle down near his base of operations.

profiles.name: Sandra & George Whitfield
profiles.description: Executive couple, George is a hospital CEO earning $280,000 and Sandra is an attorney earning $190,000. Combined income $470,000. Credit scores above 800. Looking for an estate property in Grosse Pointe around $1,500,000. Have substantial assets and stock portfolio for down payment.

profiles.name: Ashley & Ryan Thompson
profiles.description: Young couple, combined income $72,000. Credit score 620. First-time buyers excited about homeownership. Looking for a starter home around $165,000 in Flint suburbs. Limited savings at $7,000. Both work in healthcare, Ashley as a CNA and Ryan as an EMT.

profiles.name: Richard & Carol Peterson
profiles.description: Semi-retired couple with pension and social security income totaling $56,000. Credit score 680. Want to downsize to a small home in rural Cheboygan County around $140,000. Currently own a larger home outright. Looking for peaceful retirement community in northern Michigan countryside.

profiles.name: Nadia & Alex Petrov
profiles.description: Dual income professionals, combined $140,000. Good credit at 730. Looking for a home in Canton Township around $370,000. Both work in automotive engineering. Have 10% down payment saved. Second home purchase, relocating from Ohio for job opportunity with major automaker.

profiles.name: William Cooper
profiles.description: Successful business owner, sole proprietor of a construction company netting $250,000 annually. Credit score 755. Looking for a large custom home on acreage in Oakland County around $800,000. Has 20% down payment ready. Experienced buyer, this would be his fourth property.

profiles.name: Jasmine Williams
profiles.description: Single mother, registered nurse earning $68,000. Credit score 660 improving after divorce. First-time buyer looking for a safe neighborhood in Southfield around $210,000. Has $8,500 saved plus employer down payment assistance. Two school-age children, prioritizing good schools.

profiles.name: Eric & Dana Lindstrom
profiles.description: Married couple, combined income $125,000. Very good credit at 740. Eric is a senior accountant and Dana is a project manager. Looking to buy a home in Plymouth around $380,000 with 15% down payment. Move-up buyers selling their first home in Livonia. Want more space for growing family.
